summary: The audit-binding gate has no green path once any audit cites scripts/audit-binding-exceptions.json: excusing that binding writes the ledger, which changes the ledger digest, which invalidates the excuse just written. Four consecutive --grandfather runs produced four different ledger digests and check still exited 1.
cost: One red CI round plus a sandboxed convergence probe; the only route to green is hand-pruning one ledger entry and rebinding another cycle's merged audit, which is what the excuse-rather-than-rebind precedent exists to prevent.
owner: EHotwagner/rogue3 — scripts/check-audit-bindings.py and the audit schema
